en: Oh! You found me... Please don't tell anyone I'm hiding out here. My fans never give me a moment's peace.
If you keep my secret, I'll give you this. My Fearow and I used it in all of our films.
TM47 is Steel Wing. It hits hard, and it can make the user's Defense rise too!
It's so quiet out here. Nobody comes this far west but the toughest trainers.
